result.instructions: Tools for Inventory Now, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many blue mugs are left, and where are they stored?"; "What is low on stock in the back room?"; "Record a sale of 5 Widget A to Acme Corp with 7% tax.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Inventory Now data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run inventorynow_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run inventorynow_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run inventorynow_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. inventorynow_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: inventorynow_list_items
tools.title: List items
tools.description: List inventory items, newest change first, with stock on hand (bought − sold − loss), prices, custom fields and barcodes. Filter by search text, category, location or stock status. Inventory Now API: GET /items.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Request page + 1 until an empty array comes back.

per_page.description: Items per page (default 50 once paging is on).

search.description: Matches name, category, location, notes, description, barcode, SKU and custom fields.

from_date.description: Item date on or after yyyy-mm-dd.

to_date.description: Item date on or before yyyy-mm-dd.

tools.name: inventorynow_get_item
tools.title: Get an item
tools.description: Get one item by id, with its photos, its expenses and profit figures (true_profit, true_margin). Inventory Now API: GET /items/{id}.

tools.name: inventorynow_get_items_summary
tools.title: Get items summary
tools.description: Quick checksum of the whole inventory: sum, count, bought_sum and sold_sum (deleted items excluded). This is not a stock value or profit report. Inventory Now API: GET /items/summary.

tools.name: inventorynow_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List buy (supplier purchase) and sell (customer sale) orders, newest first, 100 per page, cancelled orders excluded. Use updated_since to see changes, including cancellations. Inventory Now API: GET /orders.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Request page + 1 until an empty array comes back.

order_type.description: Only buy or only sell orders.

item_id.description: Only orders that contain this item id.

search.description: Matches notes, customer info, #id, item names, SKUs, barcodes and categories.

updated_since.description: ISO 8601 time. Only orders changed at or after it, including cancelled ones.

tools.name: inventorynow_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get one order with its lines, items, expenses and expense-aware profit. Inventory Now API: GET /orders/{id}.

tools.name: inventorynow_get_settings
tools.title: Get account settings
tools.description: Get the account's settings: currency symbol, the labels for category, location and custom fields, the low-stock default and which order status steps are on. Inventory Now API: GET /user_settings.

tools.name: inventorynow_create_item
tools.title: Create an item
tools.description: Create an inventory item. Starts at zero stock: add stock with inventorynow_create_order (buy). If an item with the same internal_id already exists it is updated instead, so a stable internal_id makes a retry safe. Inventory Now API: POST /items.

internal_id.description: Your own stable id (a UUID works). Generated if omitted.

category.description: Category (the label is set in account settings).

barcode.description: Barcode. Must be unique among live items.

sku.description: SKU. Must be unique among live items.

unit_cost_buy.description: Default unit purchase cost, used when an order line has no cost.

unit_cost_sell.description: Default unit sale price, used when an order line has no cost.

is_favorite.description: Pin the item to the top of lists.

image_name.description: Primary image URL. Inventory Now copies an outside link into its storage shortly after the save.

tools.name: inventorynow_update_item
tools.title: Update an item
tools.description: Update an item. Only the fields you send change. Stock counts are not changed here: use inventorynow_create_order. Inventory Now API: PUT /items/{id}.

item_id.description: The item id to update (from inventorynow_list_items).

category.description: Category (the label is set in account settings).

barcode.description: Barcode. Must be unique among live items.

sku.description: SKU. Must be unique among live items.

unit_cost_buy.description: Default unit purchase cost, used when an order line has no cost.

unit_cost_sell.description: Default unit sale price, used when an order line has no cost.

is_favorite.description: Pin the item to the top of lists.

image_name.description: Primary image URL. Inventory Now copies an outside link into its storage shortly after the save.

tools.name: inventorynow_create_order
tools.title: Record a buy or sell order
tools.description: Record a purchase (buy, adds stock) or a sale (sell, removes stock) with one or more lines. A sale of more units than are on hand fails unless back orders are on. Set adjust_stock to false to record the order without moving stock. Inventory Now API: POST /orders.

order_type.description: buy = purchase from a supplier; sell = sale to a customer.

item_id.description: The item bought or sold (id from inventorynow_list_items).

cost.description: Line total, not unit price. Defaults to quantity × the item's unit cost (buy) or unit sell price (sell).

customer_info.description: Customer or supplier details. The first line is the name.

fees.description: Flat fees added to the total.

paid.description: Default true. Send false for an invoice that is still outstanding.

adjust_stock.description: Default true. false records the order without touching stock counts.

client_operation_id.description: Your retry key. Reuse it only to repeat the same create.

annotations.title: Record a buy or sell order

tools.name: inventorynow_complete_order
tools.title: Complete an order
tools.description: Mark an order completed and paid. If the account uses order status steps, completing also moves them. Inventory Now API: PUT /orders/{id}/complete.

tools.name: inventorynow_cancel_order
tools.title: Cancel an order
tools.description: Cancel an order and put its stock back: the counts the order moved are reversed. The order stays on record as cancelled. Inventory Now API: PUT /orders/{id}/cancel.

order_id.description: The order id to cancel (from inventorynow_list_orders).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Inventory Now
prompts.description: What you can do with Inventory Now here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: check_stock_on_hand_for_an_item
prompts.title: Check stock on hand for an item
prompts.description: Search items by text, category, location or stock status. Open one item for its stock, expenses and profit figures.

prompts.name: review_buy_and_sell_orders_from_the_last_week
prompts.title: Review buy and sell orders from the last week
prompts.description: List orders, newest first. Use the updated-since filter to see cancellations. Open one order for its lines and profit.

prompts.name: read_the_inventory_totals_and_account_labels
prompts.title: Read the inventory totals and account labels
prompts.description: Read the sum, count, bought and sold totals of the whole inventory. Read the labels for categories, locations and custom fields.

prompts.name: record_a_buy_or_sell_order
prompts.title: Record a buy or sell order
prompts.description: Record a buy order to add stock, or a sell order to remove it. A sale above the stock on hand fails unless back orders are on.

prompts.name: cancel_an_order_and_restore_its_stock
prompts.title: Cancel an order and restore its stock
prompts.description: Cancel an order. The stock counts it moved are reversed, and the order stays on record as cancelled.

prompts.name: add_a_new_item_or_update_its_details
prompts.title: Add a new item or update its details
prompts.description: Create an item with a stable internal id, so a retry is safe. Update item fields; stock changes only through orders.
